title: Mountain Admission and Season Dates for Lift Tickets
content:
Every product in the Lift Tickets line admits its holder from 2026-11-20, the first date the product admits the holder, through 2027-04-18, the last date it admits the holder. Within that season each product carries its own set of mountains, its own validity period and its own gate limits.

## Mountains admitted

| Product | Mountains admitted | More than one mountain on the same calendar day |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | Granite Ridge | not allowed |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek | not allowed |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow | allowed |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow | allowed |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Copper Hollow | allowed |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | allowed |

## Named ski date and validity period

The three day products — the Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket and the two advance tickets — name the ski date when the order is bought, and their validity period is 1 calendar day from the first valid date. The three packs do not name a ski date at purchase, and their validity period is 150 calendar days from the first valid date, being the number of calendar days from that date within which the days on the order must be used.

## Dates on which a product does not admit the holder

- Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket and Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack: 2026-12-26, 2026-12-27, 2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01.
- Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack: 2026-12-26 and 2026-12-31.
- Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket, Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket and Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack: no such dates.

## Gate limits and lift privileges

| Product | Lift scans recorded on one calendar day before scanning is refused | Early-morning loading before public opening | Priority lift lane |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | 14 | no | no |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | 14 | no | no |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | 16 | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | 16 | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | 18 | yes | no |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | 20 | yes | yes |
